meets: Three fixed moments of a world 1 bot run stalled for 70 to 100 ms in the wave 36 red team, and the same run stalls on wave 35. The cause was found on 11 Nov: a headless bot run has no sound device, so the game's worker-thread audio warm-ups are off, and two radio lines and one music pad render on the main thread the first time they are asked for (audio.gd live_output, music_engine.gd _warm_stinger). With the played game's warm-up on (the bot flag --warm-band=1) all three stalls are gone and the run replays the same, so a player should not meet them. Two things still need MangoHud or a PC film: the tick on which the dam Warden breaks runs 35 to 38 ms on a loaded PC, and a radio line could wait on the audio worker if the worker is busy when the line is due (not measured). The red team's hitch replays get the warm-up flag in wave 37
evidence: gate/w36-f165fbb4/redteam/findings.md, speedrunner, tarn seed 4663, ticks 533, 4983 and 5736; replayed on dc2df550 with --warm-band=1: none of the three stalls, the events file identical
